locked_rule: All public buyer themes must be fed by governed KKr / II / MC-BOT metadata, not one-off page guesses.

roles.PIX: Parent/source object. Useful metadata, but partial.
roles.KK: Primary buyer-match unit. KK labeling must carry most match weight.
roles.II: Reusable delivery/matching object. One II may support many routes.
roles.KKr: Runs multiple metadata/labeling loops and candidate selection.
roles.MC-BOT: Buyer-facing guide that narrows intent, explains choices, and routes to Featured, More, or More-like-this.

theme_groups.mc_bot_role: Ask what kind of dad moment this is: thanks, strength, missing dad, repair, proud, support, cowboy, hardworking, funny, quiet, bonus dad.
Guide gratitude, repair, mom support, warmth, and thank-you paths.
Narrow age, tone, relationship, fun vs heartfelt, family vs friend.
Narrow gratitude: parent, friend, mentor, repair, support, everyday thanks.
Narrow soft apology, repair, still care, hard to say, no pressure.
Narrow keep going, believe in you, strength, hope, battle, calm.
Narrow presence, missing them, empty chair, no words, gentle support.
Narrow romance level: gentle, new, committed, longtime, missing, repair, desire, anniversary, vow-level, private.
Narrow vow-level, first dance, forever, ceremony-safe, wedding-party thanks.

mc_bot_decision_model.first_question: What kind of feeling are you trying to send?
mc_bot_decision_model.third_question: Should it feel simple, deep, funny, tender, strong, romantic, or private?

candidate_laws: No direct same-holiday LT-PIX by default.
No Music Maykers in public UI.
No mKs / mini-KUTs in public buyer flow unless ADMIN override is active.
No duplicate II unless ADMIN explicitly directs it.
Customer-ready delivery audio requires padding + Twinkle together.
BIC-level release = production audit pass, not local build pass.
